description: Writes SEO-friendly, accessible alt text for an image file on this computer (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 3 MB). The file is sent to the AltTextGeneratorAI service. Only image files inside the user's home folder or the temp folder are read, unless the user chose other folders with ALTTEXTGENERATORAI_ALLOWED_DIR. Uses 1 credit.

file_path.description: Path of the image file on this computer.

language.description: Language of the alt text, in English, for example spanish, french, german or japanese. Defaults to english. 130+ languages are supported.

name: generate_alt_text_from_file
title: Generate alt text from a local image file
